headlines.title: 연금 개혁 후속 작업 본격화 …다층 노후소득보장체계 논의
headlines.summary: 연금특위 범부처 지원 TF 2차 회의 열어 국민·기초·퇴직·개인연금 연계 강화 방안 논의 기금수익률 제고·재정안정화 대책 지속 추진 이형일 재경부 1차관이 국회 연금계획 특별위원회 범부처지원 TF 제2차 회의에서 발언하고 있다.

headlines.title: 연금특위 정부 TF 재가동… 구조개혁 논의
headlines.summary: 국회 연금특위 지원…제도별 추진 성과 공유 국민·기초·퇴직연금 등 구조 개혁 머리 맞대 보건복지부. [연합뉴스] 정부가 연금개혁 특별위원회(연금특위) 범부처 지원 태스크포스(TF) 회의를 1년 2개월 만에 재가동했다. 국민·기초·퇴직·개인연금 등 연금 전반의 제도 개선을 위한 구조개혁 방안 논의에 나선 것이다.

headlines.title: 연기금투자풀 100조 원 눈앞… 국민성장 펀드 1100억 원 유치
headlines.summary: 무역보험기금 합류로 1000억원 돌파…대체투자상품 중 최단 기록 기획예산처. ⓒ데일리안DB [데일리안 = 박진석 기자] 연기금투자풀을 통해 조성된 연기금용 국민성장펀드가 출범 일주일 만에 1100억원을 모으며 역대 가장 빠른 자금 모집 기록을 세웠다. 연초 제도 개선 이후 공공자금의 혁신성장 투자 확대가 본격화하는 모습이다.

headlines.title: “ MSCI 편입 유보 파장은 제한적 … 추세적 상승 여력 충분 ” [韓, MSCI 선진...

headlines.summary: 롯데칠성음료, 식음료 업계 '첫 가격 인상' 햄버거·외식·커피 프랜차이즈 '도미노 인상' "알루미늄 가격이 치솟으면서 병뚜껑 가격이 현재 3배가 올랐어요. 이마저도 병뚜껑을 포장하는 비닐 회사가 원자재를 구할 수 없어 생산을 중단하면서 조달조차 어려운 상황입니다." (국내 중견 식품기업 임원 A씨) 중동 전쟁의 후폭풍이 한국 식탁을 뒤흔들고 있다.

headlines.title: “ 집값상승 · 빚투 에 금융취약성 확대 ”… 한국은행의 경고
headlines.summary: 신현송 취임 첫 금융안정보고서 코스피 연일 급등락에 불안 가중 한국은행은 신현송 총재 취임 이후 첫 금융안정보고서에서 빚투(빚 내서 투자) 증가, 집값 오름세가 금융 불균형과 취약부문 부실 확대를 가져올 수 있다고 경고했다.

headlines.title: “ 하루 평균 8곳 폐업 ”… 중소건설사, 금리인상 땐 줄도산 우려
headlines.summary: 전문건설사 5월 폐업 240곳, 1년새 26% 급증 중동전쟁·고환율·원자잿값에 한계상황 직면 “대형사는 수주 늘어…중소사 일감 경쟁 밀려” 하반기 금리인상시 금융부담 가중…파산 공포 건설경기 불황과 중동 전쟁 등 겹악재가 지속하면서 중소건설사가 한계 상황에 직면해 있다. 경제 전문가와 업계에선 이들 회사를 지원하는 핀셋 정책이 시급하다고 진단한다.

headlines.title: ‘ 미분양·PF·수주절벽 ’ 3중고 “협회비도 못내는 업체 수두룩”

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is facing mounting financial vulnerabilities as the Bank of Korea warns of risks from leveraged investing and soaring property prices threatening financial stability. The government is moving proactively with a major real estate forum scheduled for July and aggressive housing supply initiatives, with officials emphasizing the urgency to build more homes. Semiconductor industry participants are basking in record profits driven by AI infrastructure demand, though market experts increasingly warn of approaching price adjustments and supply oversupply. Major announcements regarding new semiconductor facilities and AI data center investments are expected, signaling government commitment to regional development and technological advancement. Overall business sentiment remains split between semiconductor and export strength and broader economic weakness affecting most other sectors.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The minimum wage debate continues with economists advocating for incorporation of economic growth rates and inflation figures into decision-making processes, mirroring practices in other nations. The government faces significant fiscal pressures regarding basic pension system reforms, with analysis suggesting restructuring could increase budget burdens beyond current levels. Concerns mount over financial instability stemming from leveraged investing and asset concentration in real estate, prompting calls for interest rate increases to control inflation and protect vulnerable populations. Business sentiment indicators show concerning trends with July forecasts at 98.0, suggesting continued economic difficulties despite semiconductor and export performance. Housing construction urgency is emphasized as critical for stabilizing property markets and addressing affordability crisis.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean stock market experienced significant volatility, with the KOSPI rebounding 3% after recent sharp declines, while the Korean won settled at 1,540 against the dollar amid persistent foreign investor selling. The volatility index (VKOSPI) reached record highs at 97.78, reflecting extreme market uncertainty and investor anxiety over leveraged positions and ETF investments. The Federal Reserve's hawkish stance has strengthened the dollar, with expectations for potential rate increases raising concerns about capital outflows and currency appreciation pressures. The Bank of Korea issued explicit warnings about leveraged investing and leveraged ETFs amplifying losses during market corrections and creating systemic risks. SpaceX encountered challenges in the bond market despite stock market success, with investors demanding premium rates for longer-term securities citing higher risk profiles.
sections.Industry & Technology: The semiconductor industry maintains its AI-driven growth while facing mounting concerns about peak-out potential, with Taiwan currently ahead in the current cycle but long-term competition remaining uncertain. Physical AI and robotics sectors are advancing rapidly, with low-power in-sensor computing emerging as critical technology to overcome battery limitations in next-generation autonomous systems. Secondary battery manufacturers are expanding production capacity, with PNT opening a new factory in Gumi and lithium iron phosphate batteries seeing increased demand from electric vehicles and energy storage systems. The battery industry faces critical challenges including EV demand slowdown, Chinese supply glut, and protectionist measures, making production tax credits essential for survival. Advanced robotics and AI development require significant power and infrastructure investments, positioning energy-efficient computing as a key competitive advantage.
sections.Real Estate: South Korea's real estate market shows mixed signals with strong demand for public rental housing, exemplified by 91,772 applicants competing for Happy Housing units with an average competition ratio of 48.7 to 1. New apartment complexes continue launching, such as Kim Hae Central I-Park offering 1,379 units across various sizes, indicating sustained construction activity despite market concerns. Property prices in semiconductor industry hub areas like Dongtan, Hwaseong are experiencing volatility, with contract cancellations reaching 351 cases in the first half of 2026 as buyers reassess positions following steep price increases. Government policy emphasizes urgent housing supply expansion to address affordability crisis, with officials calling for immediate construction increases and comprehensive market solutions. The government is also planning a major real estate forum to gather public input before implementing tax reforms.
sections.International Economy: Former Federal Reserve Chair Alan Greenspan passed away, concluding the legacy of the central banker who guided four U.S. administrations through 19 years of monetary policy that controlled inflation and maintained employment stability. The Trump administration continues implementing reciprocal tariff policies based on simplified trade deficit calculations, with reports indicating government officials relied on Google searches rather than formal analysis when determining tariff rates. Major Wall Street banks including Bank of America and Deutsche Bank have reversed expectations, now forecasting three potential Federal Reserve rate increases from September onward, reflecting a more hawkish policy stance than previously anticipated. Kevin Walsh's leadership of the Federal Reserve shows strong commitment to price stability, prompting recalibration of monetary policy outlooks across major financial institutions. International economic uncertainty continues with shifting tariff policies and currency volatility affecting global trade and capital flows.
sections.AI & Economy: South Korea is positioning itself as a major player in the global AI data center market, with government efforts to construct facilities in multiple regions and attract semiconductor companies to establish integrated operations. KT is pursuing merger of KT Cloud to create comprehensive AI infrastructure capabilities combining cloud services, networks, and data centers, reflecting the strategic importance of AI infrastructure in telecommunications. Japan's JERA is aggressively entering the U.S. AI infrastructure market by developing integrated projects combining data centers and power generation, demonstrating international competition for AI dominance. The government is coordinating with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix on massive semiconductor facility and AI data center investments expected to exceed hundreds of trillions won. AI agent adoption is accelerating in business operations, with company leaders comparing the impact to hiring new employees and requiring similar management approaches for optimization.
sections.Others: Daegu city is recruiting 138 participants for its youth employment experience support program through July 6th to help young people navigate labor market entry amid economic slowdown. Korea Investment Trust Management announced dividend distributions for its high-dividend stock plus covered call active ETF following its initial public offering. China's new supercomputer Linshang achieved world's fastest ranking using 100% CPU architecture without imported GPUs, surpassing U.S. El Capitan and reversing semiconductor dependency restrictions. Japan is establishing independent AI coalitions with France, India and other nations to reduce reliance on U.S. and Chinese technology dominance and build autonomous AI supply chains. Government temporary organizations created in 2023 are experiencing divergent fates, with Planning and Budget Ministry's subsidy management unit receiving permanent status while Finance Ministry units remain on uncertain temporary extensions.
